newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up as buying pressure continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up as buying pressure continues.

text.p: Sustained buying of a wide range of scrips propelled Dhaka stocks 3.43 percent up at the market close ahead of the Friday Moslem weekend, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 98.39 points or 3.43 percent at 3,547.27. Turnover was 486.6 million taka. Of 121 traded issues, 83 gained and 38 lost.
Brokers said the rally would continue next week with investor expectations flying high ahead of annual general meetings of many a companies due in next one month.
Apex Foods gained 1,104 taka to 23,177, Aziz Pipes rose 354 to 7,430 and Beximco Pharma was up 14 at 469.
